_description: Copy this file to 'local_workstation.json' and customize for your machine. The local_workstation.json file is gitignored so your settings won't be tracked.

_notes.flame_home_dir: The root directory where Flame stores project data. Example: /Volumes/MyDrive/AutodeskStorage/flame
_notes.flame_setups_dir: Optional. Usually relative to project home. Set to null to use default.
_notes.flame_media_dir: Optional. Usually relative to project home. Set to null to use default.
